 The United States secures Quarterfinals win over Haiti  
 11/18/2026 - 3:52 AM share-facebook share-x share-whatsapp share-copy-link USA Reaches the Finals  The United States also clinched a spot in the 2027 Gold Cup. 
 CINCINNATI – The United States booked its spot in the 2027 Concacaf Nations League Finals on Tuesday with a 2-nil Second Leg victory over Haiti , winning the Quarterfinals series 8-nil on aggregate at TQL Stadium in Cincinnati, United States.
 With this result, the USMNT advanced to the Finals to get the chance to lift their fourth trophy of the competition, having won the first three editions of the tournament.
 Christian Pulisic stunned the Haitian defense and the world in the first minutes of the match, in the 25’, going up in the air to perform a bicycle kick in the box to send the ball to the back of the net, scoring the first goal for the Stars and Stripes .
 View this post on Instagram 
 The hosts kept their tally going, with Julian Hall stepping up one more time for the USMNT with a right foot shot in the area to add the second goal for the North Americans, scoring his second goal in the 2026/2027 CNL Quarterfinals series.
 With this win, Mauricio Pochettino said farewell to the USMNT Head Coach role after two years, leading the team this summer in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
 The United States secured their fifth CNL Finals participation, having won three out of the past four editions of the tournament.
 Post-Match Data: USA vs. Haiti
 Weston McKennie recorded two assists in 77 minutes against Haiti, matching his combined assist total from his previous nine Concacaf Nations League appearances for the United States.
 Christian Pulisic is the United States' all-time leading goalscorer in the Concacaf Nations League with nine goals, at least two more than any other USMNT player. Weston McKennie , who assisted Pulisic's goal against Haiti, is tied for second with Ricardo Pepi , with seven goals each.
 The United States bounced back from consecutive Concacaf Nations League defeats against Panama (1-0) and Canada (2-1) with back-to-back victories over Haiti (6-0 and 2-0). This marks only the second time the USMNT has recorded consecutive wins without conceding a goal during the same international window in the competition, following its 3-0 victory over Mexico and 2-0 win against Canada in June 2023.
 The United States extended its unbeaten streak against Haiti across all competitions, including friendlies, to 12 matches (7W-5D-0L). The USMNT has won each of its last five meetings with Haiti, maintaining an unbeaten run dating back to 1976.
 Julian Hall has scored five goals in six appearances for the United States. At 18 years and 238 days old , he became the youngest player in USMNT history to reach five international goals, surpassing the previous mark held by teammate Christian Pulisic , who achieved the milestone at 18 years and 258 days.
